instruction:
You are checking `SSC-18-LH-06`, a task-owned synthetic fire pump pressure signal and alarm package.

Use only the task-owned synthetic source pack values shown below for numeric grading. Fire pump, pressure sensor, alarm threshold, NAC load, and battery workflow context shapes this instance only; it does not parse a real fire pump schematic, alarm panel export, or authority-approved fire design.

Source pack:

- Fire pump schematic: `FIRE-18-PUMP-06`
- Pressure sensor data sheet: `PRESS-18-SENSOR-06`
- Alarm threshold table: `ALM-18-THRESH-06`
- NAC/load schedule: `NAC-18-LOAD-06`
- Fire authority criterion: `CRIT-18-FIRE-06`
- Fire control memo: `MEMO-18-FIRE-06`

Given values:

| Field | Value |
| --- | ---: |
| Residual pressure | {{ residual_pressure_kpa }} kPa |
| Pressure range | {{ pressure_lower_kpa }} to {{ pressure_upper_kpa }} kPa |
| Low alarm pressure | {{ low_alarm_pressure_kpa }} kPa |
| Pump start pressure | {{ pump_start_pressure_kpa }} kPa |
| NAC devices/current | {{ nac_device_count }} at {{ nac_device_current_a }} A |
| NAC panel capacity | {{ nac_panel_capacity_a }} A |
| Control load | {{ control_load_w }} W |
| Standby/alarm duration | {{ standby_duration_h }} / {{ alarm_duration_h }} h |
| Battery capacity | {{ battery_capacity_kwh }} kWh |
| DC voltage / charger efficiency | {{ dc_voltage_v }} V / {{ charger_efficiency }} |

Required calculations:

- 4-20 mA pressure signal equals `4 + 16 x (pressure - lower range) / pressure span`.
- Alarm margins compare residual pressure to the low-alarm and pump-start thresholds.
- NAC load equals device count times device current.
- Battery required energy combines standby control load and alarm NAC load, divided by charger efficiency.

Return one JSON object with keys:

```json
{
  "pressure_signal_ma": <numeric_value>,
  "low_alarm_current_ma": <numeric_value>,
  "pump_start_current_ma": <numeric_value>,
  "low_alarm_margin_kpa": <numeric_value>,
  "pump_start_margin_kpa": <numeric_value>,
  "nac_load_a": <numeric_value>,
  "nac_panel_margin_a": <numeric_value>,
  "battery_required_kwh": <numeric_value>,
  "battery_margin_kwh": <numeric_value>,
  "overall_pass_score": <numeric_value>
}
```

Do not claim authority approval, accepted project evidence, fire-system acceptance, executable real source-pack parsing, full standards compliance, generated benchmark readiness, or benchmark readiness.
paramsToml:
[meta]
name = "fire-pump-pressure-signal-alarm-package"
description = "SSC-18 fire pump pressure signal, alarm threshold, NAC load, and battery metrics"
long_description = "Calculates source-bound fire pump control metrics from a deterministic SSC-18 task-owned source pack. The template combines pressure transmitter signal scaling, alarm threshold margins, NAC panel load, battery required energy, and an overall synthetic pass score."
discipline = "electrical"
category = "fire-pump-alarm"
standards = ["fire pump control workflow", "ISA-5", "alarm battery workflow"]
tags = ["electrical", "instrumentation", "fire-pump", "pressure", "alarm", "nac", "battery", "deterministic"]
tool_mode = "with-tool"

[params.residual_pressure_kpa]
type = "float"
unit = "kPa"
description = "FIRE-18-PUMP-06 residual pressure"
min = 520.0
max = 520.0

[params.pressure_lower_kpa]
type = "float"
unit = "kPa"
description = "PRESS-18-SENSOR-06 pressure transmitter lower range"
min = 0.0
max = 0.0

[params.pressure_upper_kpa]
type = "float"
unit = "kPa"
description = "PRESS-18-SENSOR-06 pressure transmitter upper range"
min = 1000.0
max = 1000.0

[params.low_alarm_pressure_kpa]
type = "float"
unit = "kPa"
description = "ALM-18-THRESH-06 low alarm pressure"
min = 420.0
max = 420.0

[params.pump_start_pressure_kpa]
type = "float"
unit = "kPa"
description = "ALM-18-THRESH-06 pump start pressure"
min = 450.0
max = 450.0

[params.nac_device_count]
type = "float"
description = "NAC-18-LOAD-06 NAC device count"
min = 12.0
max = 12.0

[params.nac_device_current_a]
type = "float"
unit = "A"
description = "NAC-18-LOAD-06 current per NAC device"
min = 0.15
max = 0.15

[params.nac_panel_capacity_a]
type = "float"
unit = "A"
description = "NAC-18-LOAD-06 NAC panel capacity"
min = 3.0
max = 3.0

[params.control_load_w]
type = "float"
unit = "W"
description = "NAC-18-LOAD-06 fire control load"
min = 95.0
max = 95.0

[params.standby_duration_h]
type = "float"
unit = "h"
description = "CRIT-18-FIRE-06 standby duration"
min = 24.0
max = 24.0

[params.alarm_duration_h]
type = "float"
unit = "h"
description = "CRIT-18-FIRE-06 alarm duration"
min = 0.5
max = 0.5

[params.battery_capacity_kwh]
type = "float"
unit = "kWh"
description = "NAC-18-LOAD-06 battery capacity"
min = 3.0
max = 3.0

[params.dc_voltage_v]
type = "float"
unit = "V"
description = "NAC-18-LOAD-06 DC voltage"
min = 24.0
max = 24.0

[params.charger_efficiency]
type = "float"
description = "NAC-18-LOAD-06 charger efficiency"
min = 0.85
max = 0.85

[outputs.pressure_signal_ma]
description = "4-20 mA signal at residual pressure"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.low_alarm_current_ma]
description = "4-20 mA signal at low alarm pressure"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.pump_start_current_ma]
description = "4-20 mA signal at pump-start pressure"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.low_alarm_margin_kpa]
description = "Residual pressure minus low alarm pressure"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.pump_start_margin_kpa]
description = "Residual pressure minus pump-start pressure"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.nac_load_a]
description = "Total NAC current"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.nac_panel_margin_a]
description = "NAC panel capacity minus NAC load"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.battery_required_kwh]
description = "Battery energy required for standby and alarm"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.battery_margin_kwh]
description = "Battery capacity minus required energy"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.overall_pass_score]
description = "Pass score for fire pump pressure signal and alarm checks"
tolerance = 0.03
